sermon.title: How the Holy Spirit Works in a Church Service 01/07/2018
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that Jesus, the Holy Ghost and the gospel can only be accepted or rejected. From 1 Corinthians 12–14, the Spirit manifests through each member for the profit of all, in order. Love is the more excellent way, and every member should come prepared with a psalm, teaching, revelation or prayer, so unbelievers will say God is truly among you.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Names of congregants are in the transcript only. Kept as spoken: “Acts 7 5” (the quote is Acts 7:51). Sensitive content kept as spoken: California legislators “destroying California”; adultery and homosexuality called “hell sins”; not tithing lets the devourer bring sickness; three teenage girls “just right for the pickings”; pastors and TV ministers feel “threatened”; Mormon missionaries; “if there is no interpretation shut up.”

So I get up and I’m going through this phony thank you for inviting me and I’m killing time you know I’m getting ready to tell them folks God didn’t give me anything to say I did it in the church in La Habra I’ve got up several Sundays and said I don’t have a message for today we’re gonna go home. Yeah if God didn’t send something what do you want [unclear] talk. Amen yeah.

and in the La Habra church God was moving like he did here in this message and members would add through prayer and singing and speaking. Just in the worship service and many a time I would just get up and say we don’t need a message now church we already got one the old timers isn’t that true yes to show you that it works because the people come prepared. Hallelujah and so prayer is an important part of a church service isn’t that right I will pray in the spirit I will pray with understanding. It’s got to say something I will sing with the spirit and so that’s why we sing and that’s why we pray and that’s why we speak because these are the things the Holy Ghost uses to build his church in this crowd I saw two Mormon missionaries I recognized them right off and I greeted them and welcomed them and then the Holy Spirit dropped a verse into my spirit.

And I knew my Bible I mean I didn’t have all this computer Bible and all that back then but I read my Bible and studied so much I knew where everything was and what side of the page when I opened it and about where [unclear] down at the bottom or down at the top and I could go and I could find that scripture and I read that scripture and when I read that scripture bam God spoke to me about that scripture I’d never seen or heard of in my life. Totally Revelation and then he gave me another scripture and I go to [unclear]. bam the revelation of that scripture built on the Revelation of this scripture and I spoke a truth I had never seen and I spoke a truth I never heard anybody preach and then my knowledge of the Bible took over and then.

Speaking by the inspiration. Prophetically took over all right and at the end of that folks. People were healed physically people were healed of broken hearts people addicted to sin were set free I mean everything happened at the end and the people were just so excited just really excited and they want to honor you because you’re the messenger that is something the church has got to stop doing because God used a donkey doesn’t make the donkey anything special is that an amen but these people were coming up to me just oh my God yeah and I go whoa whoa whoa.

You know you don’t do that but you see that’s Revelation and waiting on God allowed him [unclear] testing to see if I was going to wait on him or I was gonna pull something out to look good in front of the people. And believe me folks I had a lot of good messages and I could pull out a lot of good ones that God had given me but it wasn’t what the spirit was saying to the church and how many of you know we need to speak what the spirits saying to the church is that an amen yeah so is prayer important my little selfish prayer or [unclear] spirit praying big difference. Singing. Do I just come in with the latest Christian song no you come in with the song that the Holy Ghost wants to use to touch people.

We can come with Psalms hymns and spiritual songs isn’t that right in fact just a few Sundays ago God gave me a spiritual song right over there to show you that spiritual songs work he gave me a tongue and interpretation to show you that tongues and interpretation still work in the church service [unclear] you remember those services yeah. Tongues aren’t out because people don’t believe in tongues tongues just have to come in the right order. Amen. Now. When you come together each of you what each of you what each of you you don’t come to hear the mighty man and a woman of God you come prepared for God to use you if you have a Psalm a Psalm is a scripture put to music okay.

A teaching which was up here a tongue a language don’t be scared of tongues church let’s just keep it in order is that an amen a Revelation that was up here and a what interpretation and if there is no interpretation shut up. the problem is we’re shutting up and we need everything done let all things be done for edification the profit of all as it’s set up here if it’s not profiting the whole church it’s not of the spirit. Hallelujah. So each one of us let all things be done for edification each of you come prepared and let me just say this God gave me a vision [unclear] a couple of weeks three weeks ago.

the Bible says your old men [unclear] dreams your young men [unclear] visions and you know okay and so God gave me a vision and I told you I would bring it the next Sunday because the service was full three things had already been done but the next service he didn’t release me to give you that vision it’s a good vision it’s powerful it’ll change your life when we get it and. so after a couple of weeks I [unclear] complain to God you know. people are anxious to [unclear] hear this and you’re not releasing he says they need to learn because I give them something doesn’t mean the timing is there to do it I go oh yeah I forgot that there is a time for everything I’ve got many uh prophecies a month two months even a year before I could ever give them in a church for edification exhortation and comfort just because you get something doesn’t mean you do it in the church the church has to be in order it’s got to be mannerly the church service has to be well organized and mannerly done and just because you got something from God does not mean that it’s time to give it and that’s something very important I said thank you Lord man [unclear] he’s always right you ever noticed that he’s always right.

Alleluia. So. If it’s not profiting everyone before you say anything and do anything that’s the testing point is this going to profit and benefit the whole church or am I on my little hobby horse that I want to tell the church to agree with me on. And I learned as a pastor how to keep that service in order and when big mouths and attention getters spoke up I knew how to distract away the attention from them and I still know how all right now I’m not that old yet.

scriptures.text_nkjv: What is the conclusion then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will also pray with the understanding. I will sing with the spirit, and I will also sing with the understanding.
How is it then, brethren? Whenever you come together, each of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a tongue, has a revelation, has an interpretation. Let all things be done for edification.

scriptures.text_nkjv: But if all prophesy, and an unbeliever or an uninformed person comes in, he is convinced by all, he is convicted by all. And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed; and so, falling down on his face, he will worship God and report that God is truly among you.
